summary: Tested custom-role menu auto-hide (backend and frontend). Backend: 12/12 pytest pass. The permission catalog lists Maklon as granular with the 8 mak_* modules, and legacy maklon_ops is in legacy_modules. For uji_custom_menu, login returns portals [collaboration, finance, maklon, self], and hidden_modules hides every maklon-* menu except maklon-pos-engine/maklon-po-360 and every fin-* menu except fin-hpp/fin-hpp-produk. Endpoint checks: pos 200, invoices 403 with the x-rbac-denied header, POST samples 403, GET clients 200 (lookup=True, as designed), POST clients 403. Frontend: the portal selector only allows Keuangan, Maklon, Kolaborasi and Portal Saya; other cards are locked with 'Tidak ada akses'. In Maklon the 'Keuangan & Analitik' pill is gone. The hidden default landing (maklon-dashboard) redirects to the first visible menu (#vendor-admin) with the toast 'Menu ini tidak tersedia untuk peran Anda.'. Hash #maklon-billing redirects with the toast, and #maklon-po-360 opens normally. 'Terakhir' filters out hidden menus seeded into localStorage. The Ctrl+K menu list has no hidden menus and no menus from blocked portals, but its 'Pindah Portal' group still lists blocked portals. Keuangan shows the HPP pill plus a 'Hutang (AP)' pill made of shared legacy menus. Regression: superadmin sees 16/16 portals, Maklon has 4 pills (23 menus) and Keuangan has 7 pills. The Peran & Hak Akses screen shows the Maklon group with the 8 modules, and 'Konversi izin lama' worked as a draft (14 keys), then was reset without saving. uji.accounting is unchanged: 0 hidden menus and all 7 finance pills.

minor.issue: Built-in admin_maklon has 0 stored permissions; its legacy access comes from the role/PORTAL_ACCESS guard. The suggestion returns only view+export for 7 modules. It returns nothing for mak_dashboard, because mak_dashboard view/export imply maklon.view and the role does not hold that key explicitly. It suggests no create/edit/delete/approve, because _MAKLON implies needs explicit maklon.view/manage. If the owner converts and saves, admin_maklon loses the Maklon dashboard (the portal's landing page) and all write actions. Suggested fix: in suggest_from_legacy, count implied keys '<portal>.view/.manage' as held when has_portal_access is true and the role is in the legacy router guard (e.g. MAKLON_ROLES), or at least always grant view when has_portal_access.

ui_bugs.issue: PORTAL_ITEMS is static and not filtered by canAccessPortal. uji_custom_menu sees cmdk-portal-management/production/warehouse/hr. Choosing hr does nothing and shows no toast.

integration_issues.flow: Custom role > Maklon > Monitoring Progress > Monitoring CMT
integration_issues.issue: Shared legacy production menus stay visible, which is expected, but the backend rejects them: toast 'Gagal memuat monitoring CMT: Akses ditolak: butuh izin monitoring CMT (cmt.view)'. Visible menus lead to 403 for custom roles without Produksi perms.

The review expected only the HPP pill. 'Hutang (AP)' (Faktur Supplier (Bahan), Invoice Vendor CMT) is also visible, because those menus belong to Pengadaan/Produksi modules (proc_match, prod_cmt_billing) that are not granular for this role. This follows the same legacy rule as the Maklon production shortcuts; confirm with the owner whether that is wanted.

issue: The current-module caption shows the raw id 'mgmt-roles' instead of the label 'Peran & Hak Akses' in the Manajemen portal.

action_items: Filter CommandPalette 'Pindah Portal' items with canAccessPortal(role, id). Pass the allowed portal list from PortalShell, as already done for moduleSuggestions.
Fix suggest_from_legacy for roles whose legacy access is role-based (admin_maklon has 0 explicit keys), so that 'Konversi izin lama' does not drop mak_dashboard and the write actions.

Optional: either hide shared legacy menus whose backend guard the role cannot pass (e.g. Monitoring CMT needs cmt.view), or tell the owner that custom roles also need Produksi/Pengadaan module perms for those shortcuts.
critical_code_review_comments: portalAccess.moduleBlocked only blocks ids in hidden_modules or restricted by nav roles. A hash to a module of a portal the user cannot open (e.g. accounting with #maklon-billing) silently stays in the current portal with the stale hash and shows no toast.
RecentModulesFooter still writes the blocked module into localStorage briefly before the redirect. Display filtering hides it, so this is harmless, but it is noise.
Backend view_portals + get_user_portals union and the frontend canAccessPortal check for at least one visible menu are consistent; no issues found.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core hide/redirect/pills/recent/palette-modules OK; palette portal switcher not filtered)

seed_data_creation: None. The uji_custom_menu role was not modified. The admin_maklon convert was draft only and was reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use hash navigation (#mgmt-roles, #maklon-billing) after picking a portal card. Ctrl+K: data-testid cmdk-input, cmdk-module-<id>, cmdk-portal-<id>. Portal cards: portal-selector-<id>-card; locked cards contain 'Tidak ada akses'. The accounting role doc has explicit portals [finance, assets, self, collaboration, toko], so maklon/sales/procurement are not shown for it; this is pre-existing config.
